core: Pli80_host.Int_emitter: byte-addressed compiler state and ordered Write/Set_dma/Sequential_write plan; no I8080, Runner or CP/M dependencies
adapter: Pli80.Int_emitter_bridge: exact caller, resident/helper image identities, guard preconditions, wrapper scratch, derived CALL/PUSH residue and service states
Runner: Apply_host_program and preview_host_program retain Apply_host_transition; ordered Memory_write/Dispatch_bdos uses actual Cpm.Personality.dispatch_with_file_events
transaction: Deep copy actual PRE-state RAM, filesystem including physical records/logical size, and BDOS process/DMA. Execute services on those copies; buffer all factual callbacks. Require exact service resume states and final validation. Commit staged process/RAM/registers only after all checks pass; then deliver callbacks in their original order.
failed_transaction: Discard private process/RAM/filesystem and all buffered callbacks; no live changes, no successful resume, no fallback
observers: on_commit is an after-commit observer; exceptions in observers do not roll back a committed operation. Validation callbacks are read-only.
accounting: host_bdos_services counts committed native services separately. Guest steps/t-states/BDOS-entry callbacks do not count or fabricate suppressed instructions or runtime0005 RETs.
origin_tracking: Committed ordered host-program writes, including equal-valued resident data writes and actual FCB service effects, invalidate historical origins via Execution_map.invalidate_host_writes. No instruction/coverage/provenance is manufactured. Simple Apply_host_transition retains its existing image-write restriction.
guard_scope: Existing +19BB entry stub/sentinel success is validated before preparing the plan. Guard failures remain unsupported.
service_scope: A real BDOS21 nonzero result fails expected resume validation on the staged runtime. Neither +0EA0 nor a historical fallback executes.
